title: Provenance-aware toxicant-methylation evidence resource
description: Version 1.0.0 of a provenance-aware compilation of 16,681 published exposure-DNA methylation association records in 26 fields from 12 publications, tracked through 13 source-artifact entries. Includes crosswalk (22 rows), scoped qualifiers (109 rows), operation guards (16,681 rows), dictionaries, source provenance, a separate citation-only clock roster (937 memberships; no coefficients), and standard-library validation code with five synthetic tests. Source-stored zero p-values and missing standard errors are preserved. No original publication artifacts, manuscript drafts, participant data or scoring implementation are included. CC BY 4.0 is limited to original compilation/documentation and database rights the authors can license; unchanged validator/tests retain MIT. Third-party sources receive no new license. Historical source registration gap PMID30055357 and unknown acquisition/version fields are explicitly documented. Public access is not anonymous peer review.
